Owner(s).note: The EIA-860M table for August 2026 lists the owner of Joliet 9, generator 6, as Midwest Generations EME LLC. The spelling has an extra s, but it is clearly the same company. The table names one owner and gives no share, so the 100 percent is implied. I read the name in the downloaded file.

Conversion/replacement?.note: A Power Engineering article from October 2015 says the Illinois EPA issued a final air construction permit for NRG Energy to convert the three coal-fired units 6 to 8 at the Joliet plant to burn natural gas. So unit 6 is a conversion.

units.notes: The EIA-860M table for August 2026 lists generator 6 as retired in June 2023, 360.4 MW, natural gas steam turbine, operating since June 1959. That matches GEM's status, capacity and retired year. I found no document that states a carbon capture value for this unit.
